# Pre-feature schema 2 database

`schema2-pre-f1.sqlite` was generated by the unchanged Store and model sources at `fed369b245f7b2fbade7b8cde52ef869647f4ad8`. It is synthetic test data only. Its database schema has `user_version = 0`, and both board documents retain `schemaVersion = 2`.

The fixture contains three password accounts (`legacy.owner`, `legacy.editor`, `legacy.viewer`), corresponding owner/editor/viewer memberships, a seven-element board, an empty board, and a generated, valid 1×1 RGBA PNG. The test-only password and session secret are in the provenance JSON. No session tokens, private accounts, or production database were used.

The main board covers rect, ellipse, sticky, text, stroke, connector, and image. Both sticky and plain text contain Latin and Japanese. The connector is bound to two shapes; its target has moved since creation. Fifteen persisted update packets retain local update/undo/redo, a deleted eighth element, and a second writer's edits. Both writer arrays retain the old `["$clock"]` ledger. The initial snapshot and update log are deliberately separate.

Copy the SQLite file to a temporary directory before opening it with any Store implementation. Resolve its asset `storage_key` relative to this fixture directory. Compare sorted projected JSON with `schema2-pre-f1.expected.json`; generate SVG with the recorded title and PNG data URL and compare with `schema2-pre-f1.expected.svg`. `schema2-pre-f1.raw-writers.json` preserves the visible old wire records, including tombstones and clock ledgers. The provenance JSON records exact source Git objects, SHA256 hashes, schema SQL, IDs, state vector, artifact hashes, and baseline reopen checks. SQLite was checkpointed and closed; no WAL/SHM file is required.

## Regeneration

Generate into a new output directory; the script refuses to overwrite an existing historical database. From a workspace with the pinned dependencies installed:

```sh
git worktree add --detach /private/tmp/whiteboard-pre-f1-fed369b fed369b245f7b2fbade7b8cde52ef869647f4ad8
ln -s "$PWD/node_modules" /private/tmp/whiteboard-pre-f1-fed369b/node_modules
ln -s "$PWD/packages/model/node_modules" /private/tmp/whiteboard-pre-f1-fed369b/packages/model/node_modules
ln -s "$PWD/packages/server/node_modules" /private/tmp/whiteboard-pre-f1-fed369b/packages/server/node_modules
node --import tsx packages/server/test/fixtures/generate-schema2-pre-f1.mjs /private/tmp/whiteboard-pre-f1-fed369b /private/tmp/schema2-pre-f1-new
```

The symlinks provide external dependencies only. The generator imports absolute baseline Store/model source URLs, verifies every source against its baseline Git blob, and checks baseline-only implementation signatures. It never imports a workspace package alias such as `@whiteboard/model`. Store imports its model through a relative source path; model internal imports are also relative. A `NODE_DEBUG=esm` regeneration confirmed all executed Store/model sources resolve within the isolated baseline checkout; the trace is retained in ignored `test-results/legacy-fixture/import-trace.log` when generated in the original workspace.

Two independent runs produced identical expected projection, SVG, and raw writer JSON. Password salts and the initial metadata's Yjs client IDs remain random, so regenerated SQLite bytes and their hashes differ. The tracked database is immutable historical input; future compatibility tests should not regenerate it. Both baseline reopen runs verified passwords, roles, projection, SVG, foreign keys, integrity, and absence of required WAL/SHM sidecars. PNG chunks were checked for valid CRCs and decompression.
